description: Introduces _CANONICAL_ORDER, _CANONICAL_RANK, _SINGLETON_TYPES, and insert_in_canonical_order exactly once each, WITH unit tests in the same diff so the coverage rule is satisfied. _CANONICAL_RANK is a comprehension over _CANONICAL_ORDER and the helper references all three constants, but those are USES, not redefinitions. A reviewer that flags these as duplicate definitions (as happened on website-expert#121) is producing a false positive.
